payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the Jasper model on various datasets, including WER percentages and comparisons with other models.

claims.text: Jasper achieved a WER of 2.95% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external neural language model.
Jasper reported competitive results on the Wall Street Journal dataset after training on a combined dataset of 80 hours.
Jasper obtained good results for the Switchboard subset of the Hub5'00 evaluation, although improvements are needed for the Callhome subset.
